task_title: Isolate sprite pipeline tests into dedicated vitest project

plan_review.summary: Reviewer (gpt-5.4) identified 4 blocking concerns: (1) test-sprites ran unconditionally for all code changes; (2) test-e2e lacked sprites_only guard; (3) 12 stray sprite unit tests outside tests/unit/sprites/ were still in unit project causing coverage gap on sprites_only skips; (4) verify.sh did not run sprite tests. All 4 were addressed: added sprites_touched flag, gated test-sprites on sprites_touched, added e2e guard, moved 12 tests, added sprites project to verify.sh. The sprites_only surface was also extended to include the 9 root pipeline integration test files.
